visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Exterior shot of a cafe storefront painted in a soft mint green. The awning displays the words "ICE GREED" in gold-colored lettering. The lighting is bright natural daylight, reflecting off the large glass windows where passers-by can be faintly seen. A person is inside near the counter. (2) Interior shot transitioning to the dining area. The walls are mint green, adorned with ornate gold-framed mirrors. Crystal chandeliers hang from the ceiling, providing bright indoor lighting. Woven bistro chairs and marble-top tables are arranged. A small vase of purple and white flowers sits on a table in the foreground. (3) Close-up shot of a yellow scalloped bowl containing yellow mango shaved ice and a scoop of ice cream. A large, fluffy white cotton candy cloud sits on top with a purple straw. A hand pours a clear liquid over the cotton candy, causing it to shrink and melt. (4) Scooping action close-up. A metal spoon takes a generous bite of the yellow mango ice and fruit puree from the bowl. The marble table surface and the blurred green cafe background are visible. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom describing the dish. (5) Close-up shot of an amber glass filled with layered coffee-flavored shaved ice, dark coffee jelly cubes, and a thick white cream cap. A whole coffee bean sits on top. A hand uses a spoon to scoop out the jelly and cream mixture. (6) Showcase of colorful parfaits in tall glasses. One parfait features blue and white layers with a mermaid tail ornament and a shell. Another displays pink and red layers with a sunflower cookie and a pink figurine. They are served on decorative silver platters. (7) Interior shot of an ice cream display case with multiple tubs of gelato. A gloved hand uses a red and silver scoop to place dark chocolate gelato onto a waffle cone with a gold paper sleeve. The background lighting is bright and even. (8) Close-up of a three-scoop gelato cone. The flavors appear to be dark chocolate, pistachio, and a pale cream color. A small white heart-shaped spoon takes a bite of the top scoop. The mint green wall of the shop is visible behind. (9) Beverage preparation shot. A white ceramic cup filled with white cream and flakes is shown first. Then, a glass of iced coffee is filled with a brown liquid from a glass pitcher. A thin slice of fresh green lime is placed on top of the foam. (10) Outro shot featuring the interior counter with hanging green pendant lights and a gelato display. The final frame returns to the exterior storefront with a text overlay showing the shop's name, address, and social media handle for "Hoolee".

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A highly aesthetic mint-green themed ice cream shop. The interior features Victorian-style crystal chandeliers, gold-framed mirrors, and elegant marble tables. The exterior shows a modern urban storefront with a matching mint-green awning.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy acoustic guitar strumming begins immediately, accompanied by a light, rhythmic drum beat. A female narrator speaks in an enthusiastic, clear tone, introducing the ice cream shop's location. The audio is studio-clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio. (2) A subtle bubble-pop sound effect triggers as the narrator describes the specialty cotton candy mango ice. The music tempo remains upbeat at 110 BPM. The narrator's pitch rises slightly to emphasize excitement, maintaining a friendly and animated tone throughout the description. (3) A light whoosh transition sound effect accompanies a visual shift. The narrator continues at a fast speech rate, detailing the various coffee-flavored shaved ice options. The acoustic guitar backing provides a consistent, cheerful rhythmic foundation for the voice-over tracking. (4) A faint liquid pouring sound and mechanical clicks from the gelato scoop are audible under the narration. The narrator's voice maintains high emotional arousal and positive valence while listing parfait and gelato flavors. The music volume is mixed well below the speech. (5) Another soft whoosh sound effect marks the transition to the coffee section. The narrator's tone remains professional and inviting. There is a slight pause before the final closing remarks. The background music continues its steady, cheerful major-mode loop. (6) Final closing remarks are delivered with a gentle falling intonation as the narrator invites viewers to visit. The acoustic guitar music swells slightly in volume for the final second before a hard cut to silence at the end of the video.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Location Hook -> Menu Highlight 1 (Ice) -> Menu Highlight 2 (Coffee) -> Menu Highlight 3 (Parfait/Gelato) -> Outro & Address
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote 'Ice Greed,' a dessert cafe in Kaohsiung, by showcasing its visually appealing products and aesthetic interior. The video aims to attract customers looking for trendy food experiences and Instagrammable locations through high-energy narration and bright visuals.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video provides a specific address, detailed highlights of various menu items, and a clear call to action to visit the location.
